t: This is C Lidgate, a butcher's shop in Holland Park. It was founded in 1850 by Charles Lidgate, and it's still in the hands of his descendants today. That family line is the point of the place. David Lidgate, who lived from 1940 to 2024, owned the shop and was part of that long run. So when you step inside, you're looking at a business that has stayed within one family for well over a century and a half, which is a rare thing for any London shop.
